_comment: Content quality thresholds used by the build and tests. Not Google rules; our own bar.

similarity.method: 5-word shingles, Jaccard index, on the written copy only (word lists, tables, link lists, headings, crumbs, tool forms and the related-links block removed)
similarity._note: maxJaccard (0.2) applies whenever a hand-written page (tool, guide, hub, trust) is involved. maxJaccardGenerated (0.6) applies between two template-built word-list pages (generated or curated affix), which share headings-free template sentences by design.
